 2026 NBA odds, picks, predictions, best bets, player props: Experts, model backing 76ers on Wednesday
 SportsLine's experts and the SportsLine Projection Model have revealed NBA picks and best bets for Wednesday, October 28
 By
 Owen OBrien 
 Oct 28, 2026
 at
 6:13 pm ET 
 •
 3 min read
 Wednesday features a 12-game NBA slate, including LeBron James back in action when the Philadelphia 76ers travel to play the Indiana Pacers at 7 p.m. ET. The Wednesday NBA schedule also includes Magic vs. Raptors, Warriors vs. Timberwolves and Thunder vs. Magic. The SportsLine Projection Model is backing James' 76ers to cover as 5.5-point favorites against the Pacers as part of NBA best bets on Wednesday. The Over/Under for total points scored in 76ers vs. Pacers is 235.5, down two from the opening line. The SportsLine team of experts has also locked in NBA best bets, including player prop betting picks on Raptors vs. Magic and Rockets vs. Bucks.  Wednesday NBA best bets (odds subject to change): 
 76ers (-5.5) vs. Pacers (-110)
 Anthony Black, Magic, Over 13.5 total points (-122)
 Amen Thompson, Rockets, Over 25.5 total points + rebounds (-125)

 76ers (-5.5) vs. Pacers (-110)
 The 76ers are off to a 3-1 start with their new-look lineup featuring LeBron James, Jaylen Brown, Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey. Tonight is just their second road game of the season, but their one road game was a 106-100 win over the defending champion Knicks. The 76ers have the No. 6 scoring defense at 107 points per game allowed. Meanwhile, the Pacers are 2-2 this season, including 0-1 at home.  Anthony Black, Magic, Over 13.5 total points (-122)
 "Anthony Black should assume a bigger role as the Magic are dealing with a litany of injuries," SportsLine expert Prop Bet Guy Doug said. "Jalen Suggs and Paolo Banchero will both be out today, likely meaning Black assumes starting point guard duties. Black averaged 17.8 points per game last season without Suggs in 23 contests without Suggs, and put up 18 points against the Knicks when Suggs went down on Sunday."  Claim the Fanatics Sportsbook promo code CBSFAN350 to get $350 in FanCash: 
 Amen Thompson, Rockets, Over 25.5 total points + rebounds (-125)
 "The Rockets might deploy more small lineups for this game with Alperen Sengun (back) and Steven Adams (calf) out," SportsLine NBA expert Mike Barner said. "Amen Thompson has already been great on the boards, posting at least 10 rebounds in three of his four games. In addition to his rebounding prowess, he is averaging 17.0 points while shooting 53.2% from the field.
